title: Nemotron-OCR v2: NVIDIA Multilingual Document Intelligence System
summary: A high-speed, production-ready OCR model specialized in multilingual text recognition and complex document structure parsing. It utilizes a modular transformer architecture to process over 30 pages per second with high accuracy.
research_notes: Optimized for RAG and document-heavy AI agents; includes a relational module for precise reading order and logical grouping.

evolution.summary: Building on the English-only v1, v2 introduced support for over 14,000 characters across multiple scripts. It has since been integrated into the unified Nemotron-3 Nano Omni multimodal model for real-time agentic workflows.
